replacement-evidence.cypher: MATCH p=(seed:RecordVersion {key:$seed})-[:CORRECTS|SUPERSEDES|SUPERSEDED_BY|SUPPORTED_BY*1..4]-(target) WHERE ALL(n IN nodes(p) WHERE NOT n:RecordVersion OR n.key IN $qualified) AND ALL(r IN relationships(p) WHERE r.asserted_by IN $qualified) RETURN p ORDER BY target.key LIMIT 64

component-attempts.cypher: MATCH p=(seed:RecordVersion {key:$seed})-[:DERIVED_FROM|IN_SCOPE|SUPPORTED_BY*1..2]-(target:RecordVersion) WHERE ALL(n IN nodes(p) WHERE NOT n:RecordVersion OR n.key IN $qualified) AND ALL(r IN relationships(p) WHERE r.asserted_by IN $qualified) AND target.kind IN ['episodic-attempt','project-decision','result'] AND (target.component=$component OR target.component STARTS WITH $component_prefix) RETURN p ORDER BY target.key LIMIT 64

recorded-related.cypher: MATCH p=(seed:RecordVersion {key:$seed})-[:CORRECTS|SUPERSEDES|SUPERSEDED_BY|DERIVED_FROM|SUPPORTED_BY|IN_SCOPE|HAS_CONDITION*1..2]-(target) WHERE ALL(n IN nodes(p) WHERE NOT n:RecordVersion OR n.key IN $qualified) AND ALL(r IN relationships(p) WHERE type(r) IN $relations AND r.asserted_by IN $qualified) RETURN p ORDER BY target.key SKIP $offset LIMIT 32

co-routed.cypher: MATCH (seed:RecordVersion {key:$seed})<-[:ROUTES_TO]-(route:Route) WHERE seed.key IN $qualified RETURN route.key AS key,route.index_path AS index_path,route.target_path AS target_path,route.ordinal AS ordinal ORDER BY route.key SKIP $offset LIMIT 32

origin.cypher: MATCH p=(seed:RecordVersion {key:$seed})-[:ATTRIBUTED_TO]->(origin:Origin) WHERE seed.key IN $qualified AND ALL(r IN relationships(p) WHERE r.asserted_by IN $qualified) RETURN p ORDER BY origin.key SKIP $offset LIMIT 32

interpretation: Recorded canonical assertions only. Origin and co-routing are provenance/navigation, never semantic relevance or durable lesson relationships. Historical selection, outcome assembly and caveat mapping remain unavailable without independently reviewed native mappers.
